claims.statement: In the compressed exact-rank-three heavy-null state A=RMR^T with D=|det M|, heavy row u0=sqrt(c)r, H=I-u0u0^T, and max normalized complement leverage max_j u_j^T H^{-1}u_j<=epsilon<epsilon_*=(1-1/sqrt(2))^2, there is an original-coordinate complement bipartition P,Q whose cross block has Pi_3>=D(1-c)delta(epsilon)^3, delta=1/2-epsilon-sqrt(2epsilon). Hence ||p_Q||_inf<=3e[D(1-c)]^{-1/3}delta^{-1}, continuously.
Under D>=1/2, c<=61/64 and normalized complement leverage<=1/16, ||p_Q||_inf<339.450 uniformly, independent of the leakage residuals tau_J,tau_K.
